text.en:
The branch of the College of Liberal Arts of the University of the Philippines created by Act
Numbered Twenty-nine hundred fifty-six and located in the municipality of Vigan, Ilocos Sur, is transferred
to the City of Baguio, Mountain Province.
The administration and operation of this college shall be in the hands of the Board of Regents of the
University of the Philippines, as established in the Organic Law of said University, and the operating expenses
of the same shall be paid out of the funds appropriated for said University.

There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise
appropriated the sum of ten thousand pesos to cover the necessary and incidental expenses of the transfer of
said branch from the municipality of Vigan, Ilocos Sur, to the City of Baguio, Mountain Province. Any
unexpended balance shall accrue to the general funds of the University of the Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 9, 1938.
